## Indigo Cult

Jory Ravenmark and Neal Lovington investigated the Indigo Cult.
They traced the Indigo Cult to the Moon Gate.

# Session 8 - Moon Gate Battle

After being directed to investigate the Indigo Cult Jory and Neal setup a meeting with the Atlantia City Console to go over their findings.

Samual the mayor of Atlantia listened to their findings and agreed to setup a taskforce to locate the Moon Gate the cult had been using to organize the cult operations.

The Moon Gate is believed to be a transmutation circle they used in some of their rituals, but the magic used in its creation is poorly understood.

Their first task would be to find someone in the city who could give them directions to the Moon Gate.
They learned the Moon Gate was a fixture in the center of the Atlantia town square, but the local residents did not believe it was an active artifact.

After entering the town square, Jory saw an old weathered stone arch covered in moss and vines.
Next to the arch were two stone benches lying perpendicular to the stone structure with a pathway between them.
At the end of the pathway was a giant rock which looked like it had some kind of sward sticking out of it.

Neal recognized the artifact as being an Elvish Moon Blade. She attempted to remove the blade from the stone but was unable to do so.

Arlen Voss a member of the Atlantia city console who had joined the investigation, found he was able to remove the blade but doing so required more dexterity than raw strength.

Upon removing the Moon Blade from its stone casing, the transmutation circle lit up, and several monsters emerged out of the Moon Gate.
